info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Operations Status API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the status of payments processed through correspondent banks. This API allows users to monitor and track operations related to banking payments, ensuring timely updates and transparency for stakeholders. Typical consumers include banking institutions, financial service providers, and payment processing systems that require status updates for compliance and operational efficiency. By utilizing this API, organizations can proactively manage payment workflows and respond swiftly to any issues that may arise.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of correspondent bank operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of correspondent bank operations, providing insights into their processing state and any relevant details related to the transaction status.
